text: A traceroute showing 40% loss at hop 6 and 0% loss at hops 7 through 15 indicates a fault at hop 6.
explanation: False. Routers rate-limit ICMP responses about themselves to protect their control plane. Loss that does not propagate to subsequent hops is a measurement artefact, not a fault — traffic passing through hop 6 is demonstrably fine, as proved by the clean results beyond it. Only loss that persists through later hops is real.
